import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_63/training_9.csv",
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# UNION all source tables (concatenate vertically)
Target9_63 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema exactly
Target9_63 = Target9_63.astype({
    'admit': 'int64',
    'gre': 'int64',
    'gpa': 'float64',
    'prestige': 'int64'
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target9_63.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_63/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
